added_comments.text: Upstream senders (e.g. the shipping webhook) may redeliver the same event; its id carries their idempotency key, so each id is notified at most once regardless of how far apart retries arrive.

rationale: The agent removed the time-window heuristic (DEDUPE_WINDOW_MS/lastSeen) entirely and replaced it with exactly-once dedupe keyed on the event's idempotency-derived id, fixing the actual class of bug (redeliveries beyond any arbitrary window) rather than widening the window or adding a special case; it also removed a redundant init() call in subscribers.ts that was double-registering listeners, another genuine root cause of duplicate sends. The payment.failed bypass-of-opt-out behavior is untouched and is explicitly re-verified by a new passing test.
